title: Pooled 10 coins: forced-selloff cascade long (1h, 24 h) and 4h Donchian 55/20, fee-net, DEV and VALIDATION

what.name: Coins
what.value_plain: BTC, ETH, ADA, AVAX, BNB, DOGE, LINK, LTC, SOL, XRP (1m perp candles resampled)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Rule A
what.value_plain: long at next 1h open after a 1h drop of 3% or more on 3x volume (median of previous 720 bars), held 24 h, one position per coin; frozen from FLOW/PREREG.md
what.label: OURS

what.name: Rule B
what.value_plain: 4h Donchian 55/20, long and short; frozen from TREND/PREREG.md
what.label: OURS

what.name: Counting
what.value_plain: A: net aggregated per UTC day, per-day t; B: per exit month, monthly t
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 10 bp round trip from backtest/fees.py, price and fee only, no funding
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Placebo
what.value_plain: 200 draws, seed 11; pass bar t >= 2.5, mean net > 0, above placebo 95th pct on VALIDATION
what.label: OURS

how: DEV 60% of the window, 30 day gap, then VALIDATION; rules, fees and thresholds are not changed. Full tables in POOLED/tables.md.
window: DEV and VALIDATION, 2022-01 to 2026-09 for BTC/ETH, 2022-01 to 2024-06 for the eight alts

verdict.label: Both rules FAIL on VALIDATION: no fee-net edge

why: Rule A DEV looked good (596 events on 198 days, per-day t 1.57, placebo 100th pct) but VALIDATION is negative: -0.43% per event, per-day t -0.36, placebo 44th pct.
Rule B VALIDATION: 354 trades, +0.59% per trade, monthly t 1.11, placebo 80th pct (p95 +1.15%); not separable from being long.
VALIDATION for A is mostly BTC and ETH; the eight alts have only about three months there and all are negative.
No edge claim, no forecast. About 100 studies listed in TESTED_MAP.md, so a pass needed more than t 2.
